from cache import make_key
from service import score

def test_cache_invalidation():
    store = {}
    compute = lambda: 42
    job_text = 'job'
    profile_version = 'v1'
    criteria_version = 'c1'
    
    # first call
    res1 = score(store, job_text, profile_version, criteria_version, compute)
    assert res1 == 42
    
    # change job_text -> should recompute
    res2 = score(store, 'job2', profile_version, criteria_version, compute)
    assert res2 == 42  # new value
    assert store[make_key('job2', profile_version, criteria_version)] == 42
    
    # change profile_version -> should recompute
    res3 = score(store, job_text, 'v2', criteria_version, compute)
    assert res3 == 42  # new value
    # store should now have key for ('job','v2',criteria_version)
    
    # change criteria_version -> should recompute
    res4 = score(store, job_text, profile_version, 'c2', compute)
    assert res4 == 42
    
    # unchanged inputs reuse cache
    res5 = score(store, job_text, profile_version, criteria_version, compute)
    assert res5 == 42  # should reuse first cache entry
    
    # test with None values
    store2 = {}
    res6 = score(store2, None, None, None, lambda: 99)
    assert res6 == 99
    res7 = score(store2, None, None, None, lambda: 100)  # different compute
    # compute should be called again because key same but store already has value
    # Actually store already has key (None,None,None) with value 99, so reuse
    # So res7 should be 99, not 100
    assert res7 == 99
    # change one None to something else -> recompute
    res8 = score(store2, None, None, 'c2', lambda: 101)
    assert res8 == 101
    # reuse None key
    res9 = score(store2, None, None, None, lambda: 102)
    assert res9 == 99  # reuse
    
    # ensure key is tuple and does not do ambiguous concatenation
    key = make_key('t', 'p', 'c')
    assert isinstance(key, tuple)
    assert len(key) == 3

def test_make_key():
    key = make_key('text', 'profile', 'criteria')
    assert key == ('text', 'profile', 'criteria')
    key2 = make_key(None, None, None)
    assert key2 == (None, None, None)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_cache_invalidation()
    test_make_key()
    print('All tests passed')
